display_long_description:
Welcome to the most intense off-road VR racing experience on Meta Quest!

Storm Racer puts you directly in the driver’s seat of custom-built racing machines. Whether you’re steering a rugged monster truck or a nimble racing buggy, every turn and jump feels real in fully immersive virtual reality.

DYNAMIC ENVIRONMENTS Race through beautifully crafted levels filled with life. From scenic coastal tracks decorated with hot air balloons to intense industrial zones and snowy paths, the variety keeps the challenge fresh. Watch out for the terrain—mud and dirt will test your handling skills to the limit!

KEY FEATURES:

Immersive Cockpit View: Feel the scale and speed with a detailed interior UI, including functional speedometers and race stats.

Nitro Boost: Time your Nitro perfectly to overtake opponents and clinch the victory.

Diverse Vehicle Roster: Choose from a variety of vehicles, each with unique handling—from classic beetles modified for dirt to heavy-duty 4x4 trucks.

Progression System: Earn scores from your races to unlock more challenging levels. Level 1 is just the beginning; do you have what it takes to unlock the elite tracks?

Competitive AI: Face off against skilled AI drivers who won't give up their position easily.

Storm Racer is optimized for Meta Quest to provide smooth performance and high-octane fun. Put on your headset, grab the wheel, and leave your rivals in the dust!
